name: collection-week
title: Portfolio collection week
subtitle: Fictional demo until your own records are imported.

sections.title: Reporting requirements
sections.sql: select company,owner,metric,period,due,value,currency,state from collection_week order by due,company,metric

sections.title: Overdue and incomplete
sections.sql: select company,owner,issue,due from attention order by due nulls first,company

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select c.name as company,a.title,a.owner,a.due from actions a join companies c on c.id=a.company_id where closed_at is null order by due

sections.title: Period comparisons
sections.note: Currencies stay separate. Missing values are not zero. Previous period means previous reported period, which can have gaps.
sections.sql: select company,metric,period,value,currency,previous_period,previous_value,change_percent,review_state,target_state from metric_variance order by company,period desc,metric
